name: Drupal.org Links
description: Various field formatters to output links to Drupal.org.
project_description:
A collection of field formatters that turn a numeric field value into a link to a page on drupal.org.

Current formatters:

Drupal.org user link (drupal_uid_link) - converts a number to a link in the format https://www.drupal.org/user/[VALUE].
Drupal.org node link (drupal_nid_link) - converts a number to a link in the format https://www.drupal.org/node/[VALUE].
Drupal.org comment link (drupal_cid_link) - converts a number to a link in the format https://www.drupal.org/comment/[VALUE].

All three formatters apply to integer, decimal and string fields; the stored value is cast to an integer before the URL is built. The formatters have no settings, no permissions, no config schema and no dependencies beyond Drupal core.
